items.title: Anthropic turns Claude into an office suite: Sheets, Whiteboards and Data
items.summary: From 10 November Anthropic began rolling out Claude Sheets (spreadsheets created and edited in natural language, multiple tabs, formulas, XLSX/CSV export) and Claude Whiteboards (shared boards for project planning) in beta. Dashboards renamed Claude Data and generally available, with certified queries and live sharing in beta. Sources disagree on which plans get access.
items.why_it_matters: Claude goes directly against Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

items.title: ChatGPT gets verified Business Agents (beta) letting users talk directly to brands
items.summary: OpenAI launched a beta of business features in ChatGPT on 10 November. Verified Business Agents let users start a branded conversation with a company when it appears in an answer. Companies claim and verify their profile in a Business Hub showing how often they are mentioned in ChatGPT. Rollout starts with selected US online stores and services.
items.why_it_matters: ChatGPT becomes a channel between customer and brand, a new visibility field for companies.

items.title: Cursor makes Projects multiplayer: teams share agents, context and task board
items.summary: Cursor says in a 10 November blog post that Projects is now multiplayer, rolling out in beta to all users. Team members join a shared project with shared context, a common task board and agents that coordinate in real time. Source is third-party coverage of Cursor's post.
items.why_it_matters: AI agents move from individuals to teams.
